articles.title: Nabarangpur Planning Meet: MLA Warns Officials Over Delayed Bridge Work
articles.description: ‘ #ଇଚ ୍ଛା_ହେଲେ_କାମ_କର #ନହ େଲେ_ଜିଲ୍ଲା_ଛାଡ଼’ ଇଚ୍ଛା ହେଲେ କାମ କର, ନହେଲେ ଜିଲ୍ଲା ଛାଡ଼। ନବରଙ୍ଗପୁର ଜିଲ୍ଲା ଯୋଜନା କମିଟି ବୈଠକରେ ଅଧିକାରୀଙ୍କ ଉପରେ ବର୍ଷିଲେ ଡାବୁଗାଁ ବିଧାୟକ ମନୋହର ରନ୍ଧାରୀ । ବ୍ରିଜ୍ କାମରେ ଅହେତୁକ ବିଳମ୍ବ ପାଇଁ ଗ୍ରାମ୍ୟ ନିର୍ମାଣ ବିଭାଜନ-୧ର ଅଧିକାରୀଙ୍କ ଉପରେ ଅସନ୍ତୋଷ ଝାଡ଼ିଥିଲେ ବିଧାୟକ। ତାଙ୍କ ଅଭିଯୋଗ ଅନୁସାରେ, ଦୁଇ ବର୍ଷ ଧରି ଜିଲ୍ଲାରେ ଆଖିଦୃଶିଆ ବିକାଶ କାମ ହୋଇନାହିଁ। ଯେଉଁ କାମ କରାଯାଉଛି ତାହା ନିମ୍ନମାନର। ଅଧିକାରୀ ଓ ଠିକାଦାରଙ୍କ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ମଧୁଚନ୍ଦ୍ରିକା ଯୋଗୁ କାମରେ ବିଳମ୍ବ ସହିତ ଟେଣ୍ଡର ଫିକ୍ସିଂ ହେଉଥିବା ମଧ୍ୟ ସେ ଅଭିଯୋଗ ଆଣିଛନ୍ତି। ଏଣୁ କାମ କରିବାର ଇଚ୍ଛା ନଥିଲେ ଅଧିକାରୀ ଛୁଟି ନେଇ ଘରେ ରୁହନ୍ତୁ, ନଚେତ ବଦଳି ହୋଇ କିମ୍ବା ଚାକିରି ଛାଡ଼ି ଚାଲିଯାଆନ୍ତୁ ବୋଲି କଡ଼ା ଭାଷାରେ କହିଥିଲେ ବିଧାୟକ। ସେପଟେ ବିଧାୟକଙ୍କ ଅଭିଯୋଗକୁ ଖଣ୍ଡନ କରି ଅଧିକ୍ଷଣ ଯନ୍ତ୍ରୀ କହିଛନ୍ତି, ବିଭିନ୍ନ କାମ ପାଇଁ ସରକାରଙ୍କୁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତାବ ଦିଆଯାଇଛି। ଟେଣ୍ଡର ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା ମଧ୍ୟ ଚାଲିଛି। ଅନ୍ୟପକ୍ଷରେ ଟେଣ୍ଡର ଫିକ୍ସିଂ ଅଭିଯୋଗର ପ୍ରମାଣ ମିଳିଲେ ଦୃଢ଼ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟାନୁଷ୍ଠାନ ନିଆଯିବ ବୋଲି କହିଛନ୍ତି ନବରଙ୍ଗପୁର ବିଧାୟକ ତଥା ଜିଲ୍ଲା ଯୋଜନା କମିଟି ଅଧ୍ୟକ୍ଷ ଗୌରୀ ଶଙ୍କର ମାଝୀ।... #Nabarangpur #ManoharRandhari #DistrictPlanningCommittee #OdishaPolitics #DevelopmentWork #TenderFixing #BridgeWork #OdishaNews #OdishaTV #OTV At the Nabarangpur District Planning Committee meeting, Dabugam MLA Manohar Randhari criticised officials over delays in bridge construction and alleged that development work in the district has been slow and of poor quality. He also alleged a nexus between officials and contractors and raised allegations of tender fixing. The Superintending Engineer rejected the allegations, saying proposals for various works have been submitted to the government and tender processes are underway. Nabarangpur MLA and District Planning Committee Chairman Gouri Shankar Majhi said strict action would be taken if evidence of tender fixing is found. articles.title: FGG seeks probe into alleged irregularities in HRDCL road works
articles.description:
HYDERABAD: The Forum for Good Governance (FGG) has sought a comprehensive inquiry into the functioning of Hyderabad Road Development Corporation Limited (HRDCL), alleging financial and procedural irregularities in road works and tendering. FGG president M Padmanabha Reddy submitted a representation to Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy on September 18. He sought a probe by the [...]HYDERABAD: The Forum for Good Governance (FGG) has sought a comprehensive inquiry into the functioning of Hyderabad Road Development Corporation Limited (HRDCL), alleging financial and procedural irregularities in road works and tendering. FGG president M Padmanabha Reddy submitted a representation to Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy on September 18. He sought a probe by the Director General, Vigilance and Enforcement, into HRDCL’s loans, expenditure, administrative activities and tendering process. FGG alleged that HRDCL had raised loans totalling nearly ₹5,000 crore since its formation in 2017. The forum also claimed that the state budget and Legislative Assembly did not adequately reflect details of the loans, expenditure and works taken up by the corporation.

FGG questions tender cancellations and new packages

The forum said the government created HRDCL as a special purpose vehicle through G.O. No. 106 on March 11, 2017. It questioned the need for the corporation since the Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC) and Roads and Buildings Department already handle road-related works in Hyderabad. According to FGG, HRDCL raised a ₹1,500-crore loan in 2025 and took up works in stages. Contractors quoted around 7% below the estimated contract value during the first stage, the forum said. For the second stage, HRDCL invited tenders for 13 works. Their estimated values ranged from ₹2 crore to ₹42 crore. FGG said several small contractors participated and quoted between 4% and 18% below the estimated values. The forum alleged that HRDCL later cancelled these tenders. It then clubbed the 13 works into larger packages and invited fresh bids after changing the tender conditions.

FGG estimates possible ₹300-crore loss

FGG said Package-I had an estimated value of ₹487.74 crore. However, the contractor quoted ₹511.45 crore, which was 4.86% above the estimate. Package-II had an estimated value of ₹571.42 crore. The quoted amount stood at ₹594.22 crore, or 3.99% above the estimate. FGG also said only two contractors participated in the re-tendering process. The forum alleged that the cancellation of the earlier tenders and subsequent clubbing of works into larger packages could have increased the government’s financial burden. FGG said its preliminary assessment indicated a possible loss of around ₹300 crore. The forum sought an inquiry into HRDCL’s loan process and use of funds. It also sought scrutiny of the corporation’s financial and administrative activities. FGG asked the government to examine why HRDCL cancelled the earlier tenders. It also sought details on the clubbing of works and changes to tender conditions. The forum further sought an inquiry into the higher bids received after the re-tendering process. It asked authorities to determine the extent of financial loss, if any, caused to the government. FGG also sought action against those found responsible. The Telangana government’s official portal identifies HRDCL as a special purpose vehicle in the state’s urban institutional structure. GHMC’s official website identifies the civic body as Hyderabad’s local government and lists road construction among its engineering works. M Padmanabha Reddy is identified as the president of FGG in the organisation’s recent publications and media reports. ]]>

articles.title: Business News | Cornea Unveils AI-Driven Pro AV Innovations and Next-Gen Displays at InfoComm India 2026
articles.description: Get latest articles and stories on Business at LatestLY. Mumbai (Maharashtra) [India], September 18: Cornea, a prominent Indian Pro AV and display solutions manufacturer, successfully showcased its latest innovations at InfoComm India 2026, held from September 16 to 18 at the Jio World Convention Centre in Mumbai. The company demonstrated its expanded ecosystem under the central theme, “One Brand for Every Display Need,” highlighting its commitment to providing a single, comprehensive source for hardware, software, and AI-enabled AV infrastructure across education, corporate, government, and institutional sectors.
